dec.pe: Workers from Bangladesh picked strawberries in Greece for months without pay. When they asked for their wages, a supervisor shot at them. A Greek court cleared the employers of trafficking. The European Court said Greece failed to protect the workers from forced labour and ordered compensation.
dec.pi: Pekerja dari Bangladesh memetik stroberi di Yunani berbulan-bulan tanpa upah. Saat mereka menagih upah, seorang mandor menembaki mereka. Pengadilan Yunani membebaskan majikan dari dakwaan perdagangan orang. Pengadilan HAM Eropa menyatakan Yunani gagal melindungi para pekerja dari kerja paksa dan memerintahkan ganti rugi.
